discovered_at: T1/T9 preflight, before any official source episode ran

inside_the_frozen_production_image.note: the image carries exactly the same thirty V2-era specifications, so the gap cannot be worked around by running inside the qualified image

evidence.observed_error: BindingError: no compiled execution specification at /opt/rvt/results/rvt_fd24/layout_execution_specifications/train/train-f1-02.json

geometry_is_not_missing.note: the frozen geometry is intact; what is absent is the compiled executable binding built from it

root_cause.generator_cannot_even_enumerate_the_v3_o: rvt_swarm/phase8/scenario.py::generate_layouts uses _SPLIT_VARIANTS = {train: (0, 1), validation: (0,)}, which produces train offsets 0.0 and 0.11 and validation offset 0.43. V3 needs 0.22 (train variant 2), 0.54 (validation variant 1) and 0.65 (validation variant 2).
root_cause.no_v3_compilation_path_exists: no module under rvt_swarm compiles a V3 execution specification, and no V3D/V3F/V3F-L/V3I artifact mentions execution specifications at all
root_cause.those_manifests_contain: only the V2-era layouts -- train variants 00 and 01, validation variant 00

statement: every one of the twenty frozen official V3 TRAIN layouts, and all ten V3 VALIDATION layouts, has no compiled layout execution specification. build_source_session loads that object to construct a runtime binding, so no official V3 source episode can start.
what_an_authorized_follow_up_must_decide: whether the twenty V3 TRAIN and ten V3 VALIDATION layout records are added to the frozen split manifests, or a separate V3 layout manifest is frozen alongside them
whether generate_layouts gains the V3 variant indices or the V3 registry geometry is compiled directly
that each compiled specification reproduces the geometry_sha256 already frozen in V3_LAYOUT_SPLIT_REGISTRY_V2, so no geometry moves
that a new production image is built from the resulting commit, since the specifications must live inside the qualified image
whether the scope guards gain an explicitly reasoned authorization entry, as RB16R and A1S3Z already have

why_no_earlier_phase_caught_it.explanation: every V3 qualification canary deliberately used the offset-0.0 layouts train-f1-00, train-f8-00 and train-f9-00, chosen precisely because the final V3 registry does not contain them, which made canary disjointness from official identities structural. Those layouts have specifications; the official V3 layouts were therefore never loaded until this phase.
why_no_earlier_phase_caught_it.what_qualification_did_not_measure: that an OFFICIAL V3 layout can be bound to a runtime session

why_this_phase_may_not_fix_it: the specifications derive from results/rvt_fd24/splits/, which is inside the protected tuple of tests/test_phase9_scope_guard.py and tests/test_phase9b_scope_guard.py, so adding the twenty V3 layout records modifies a frozen Phase-8 artifact

the production image is frozen and must not be rebuilt, so newly compiled specifications could only reach official execution through a mount -- official science reading a scientific input that is not in the qualified image is a provenance change, not a build detail
this phase's authorization covers generating TRAIN, not extending the frozen scenario-compilation authority
